page_title: NEW 0-1 EVE | Newcastle v Everton 25/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Tony Harrington has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Newcastle.

90+6' The ball is laid off to Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the roof of the net and forces Jordan Pickford to make a decent save.
90+5' William Osula slides a brilliant pass into Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker over the crossbar.
90+4' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar.

90+4' Nice individual effort by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a shot to the middle of the goal, but Nick Pope does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
90+2' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
90+2' Newcastle failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+2' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) swings in a cross from the corner, but Jordan Pickford reads it well and gathers the ball. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Newcastle.
90+1' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after William Osula (Newcastle Utd) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
89' A pass by Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
88' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with William Osula (Newcastle Utd) replacing Harvey Barnes.
88' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Beto.
87' Great solo effort from Beto (Everton)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the left post.
86' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.
83' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance!
82' James Garner (Everton) is yellow-carded.
81' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tony Harrington had an easy-decision to make.
81' David Moyes is stunned as referee Tony Harrington shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
81' Fine attempt! Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
77' The game is interrupted. Ashley Young (Everton) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
76' David Moyes decides to make a substitution. Iliman Ndiaye will be replaced by Dwight McNeil (Everton).
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) for Carlos Alcaraz.
73' Good work from Newcastle as they win a corner.
73' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
72' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
70' Substitution. Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) has come on for Jacob Murphy.
70' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
69' Beto (Everton) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.

68' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the left post, but Jordan Pickford has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
65' 0 - 1 Goal! Vitali Mykolenko plays a hopeful cross into a crowded box. Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) times his jump perfectly and sends a header into the bottom right corner from close in. 0:1.
63' Substitution. Sven Botman leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd).
62' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but Jordan Pickford comes off his line to gather the ball.

60' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a shot goalwards. The ball is directed towards the left side of the goal, but it lacks power and Jordan Pickford pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
59' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd).
57' Jack Harrison (Everton) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post.
56' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Tony Harrington blows for a foul.
54' James Garner (Everton) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
53' The linesman points to the corner flag, Everton are going to take it.

53' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Nick Pope.
51' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
50' Jack Harrison (Everton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Nick Pope intercepts the ball.
49' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
47' Surely that's handball by one of the Newcastle players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
46' Eddie Howe makes a switch. Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) is coming on in place of Anthony Gordon at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
43' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Newcastle was in an offside position.
42' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
42' The ball is cleared after Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Newcastle.
42' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
40' An accurate cross picks out Beto (Everton) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
40' There's an opportunity for James Garner (Everton) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

39' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the roof of the net. Nick Pope displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net. The ball goes out of play. Everton are awarded a corner kick.
38' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) picks up a yellow card.
38' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
38' Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) fails to turn the rebound in from a promising position. The goalkeeper pulls off a superb save and denies his effort.
37' The referee awards a corner and Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) goes over to take it.
37' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

37' Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
36' The ball goes out for a corner. Newcastle can continue in their attacking effort.
34' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) sends a lofted pass into the penalty area from a free kick, but the opposition's defence manages to control all the attacking players and thwart the threat.
33' It looks like Ashley Young (Everton) saw red with that tackle. Tony Harrington won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
32' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
32' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) quickly picks up the rebound and shoots towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save to deny him.

31' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Jordan Pickford was alert and the score remained the same.
31' Jordan Pickford (Everton) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
30' Newcastle are seeing far more of the ball now.
28' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ashley Young (Everton) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
24' Yellow card. Idrissa Gueye (Everton) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

24' James Garner (Everton) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Nick Pope, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
23' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Jordan Pickford comes off the line to clear the ball away.
23' Jack Harrison (Everton) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but his low effort is straight at Nick Pope.
22' Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) commits a rough foul. Tony Harrington stops the game and makes a call.
20' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
19' Jack Harrison (Everton) serves up a nice cross, but Nick Pope punches the ball away.
17' The referee signals a corner kick to Everton.
16' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) is about to take a corner kick.
16' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
13' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
11' James Garner (Everton) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
9' Ashley Young (Everton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tony Harrington no option but to blow his whistle.
7' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
6' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) will take the corner.
4' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Newcastle will take the kick-off.
Tony Harrington will supervise the game today.
